title: Standard10-preserving legacy-contract PPO smoke
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: Low-LR all-policy-head PPO on repaired v6 physical rules with the exact legacy observation/slot contract can complete a replayable 8k mixed source-plus-procedural rollout while keeping Standard10 source-state TV below 0.03 and greedy disagreement below 0.05. Passing is a training-mechanism gate, not strength evidence.
material_change: Rebind exact Standard10 tensors into v6legacyv4obs, reset optimizer/counters, train policy heads plus value for 8,192 physical hands against a fixed Standard10/procedural 50-50 opponent curriculum, source-KL 0.1, and audit accounting, tensor scope, checkpoint metadata, and deterministic four-street drift.
baseline: Direct frozen bridge fresh20k was -24.5683 CI[-42.8407,-6.2959]; naive v6 rebinding was much worse. This experiment must generate new environment hands and preserve the useful source contract without imitation labels or Slumbot feedback.

notes: One treatment smoke only. The immutable parent is the matched zero-update control. No Slumbot allocation from this mechanism gate.

Training completed without KL early stop: 9,013 physical environment hands, 8,229 transition-bearing hands, two optimizer updates, four immutable Standard10 opponent anchors plus 50% per-hand procedural opponents.
Outcome-blind paired 50k state gate passed. Mean TV 0.0060010 and greedy physical-action disagreement 0.0061; preflop disagreement 0.01064 was the largest street value.
Tensor audit passed: all 76 trunk/buffer tensors remained bit-exact; changes were confined to policy_head, preflop_policy_head, and value_head as preregistered.

result.summary: The repaired legacy-v4 observation/action-slot contract supported a replayable 9,013-hand v6 physical PPO smoke while preserving Standard10 closely: 50k-state mean TV 0.00600 and greedy disagreement 0.61%, with exact trunk preservation and all accounting/provenance audits passing.
result.conclusion: The training mechanism gate passes. This establishes that PPO can generate genuinely new v6 environment experience without destroying the strongest known external execution contract. It does not establish strength: direct frozen bridge Standard10 remains significantly losing at fresh20k, and the smoke used too little training for a Slumbot claim.
result.next_step: Run one preregistered approximately 65k-environment-hand treatment under the same bridge contract with matched untouched parent and multiple archived anchors; use offline source-drift and matched fresh-only multi-anchor evaluation before any larger scale-up. Do not use imitation-only or direct bridge qualification.
